title: Nurturing Indian Peppers Thali
description: A salty, chewy, cozy Chettinad style thali featuring bell peppers, chickpeas, and aromatic spices, wrapped in a corn husk and gently steamed in a bain-marie.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Soak corn husks in warm water for 10 minutes to soften them.
In a large bowl, combine sliced peppers, onion, garlic, ginger, chickpeas and coconut milk.
Stir in molasses, cumin seeds, coriander powder, black pepper, and salt.
Heat coconut oil in a small pan, add dried red chilies, then pour the tempering over the mixture.
Spread the mixture evenly onto the softened corn husks, fold the husks into small parcels and place them on the prepared baking sheet.
Set up a bain-marie by filling a larger pan with 2 inches of water and arranging the parchment paper with parcels inside a heatproof dish.
Place the dish in the oven and bake for 30 minutes, then remove and flip each parcel, baking another 10 minutes until the mixture is thickened and slightly caramelized.
Take the parcels out, garnish with chopped cilantro and lemon zest, and serve them in a traditional Indian thali setting.
Enjoy the savory, chewy flavors of this comforting, plant‑based Chettinad pepper thali.
